Trauermarsch zu Thorwaldsens Beisetzung in der Frauenkirche
Funeral March for Thorvaldsen's Interment in The Church of Our Lady

event.desc: Memorial concert for King Frederik VII in Cæciliaforeningen.
Concerts with pupils from Det Kongelige Blindeinstitut.

history.p: The Funeral March was written for the funeral of the Danish sculptor Bertel Thorvaldsen, who had died on 24 March 1844. It was later used for almost every royal funeral up to the present times and for Hartmann's own funeral. It was published in numerous editions and arrangements.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in brown leather half binding with marbled sides and leather corners. The monogram of King Frederik IX, the name of the composer and title stamped in gold. Title above the first stave: "Sørgemarsch. / brugt for første Gang ved Thorvaldsens Bisættelse i Frue Kirke d: 30 Marts 1844." At the end of the music signed and dated: "I:P:E: Hartmann 27/3 44."
